startup_broadcasts.body: Editorial architecture changed at the shared source. Subsection = stable mutable collection of related definitions, lemmas, proofs, theorems, refinements and resolved objections; do not create one new Subsection per result. Read existing relevant Subsections, revise current compositions where appropriate; create a new Subsection for distinct substantial developments, and group mature themes under coherent Sections. Section and Article manuscripts are generated from child compositions, not independently authored. Article XIV now has five thematic Sections; Article XI has five; Article XV has four. Check live Article memberships and revisions before publishing, and avoid old assumptions that these Articles each have one catch-all Section. Use research notes for selective preliminary/negative findings; preserve IDs and publication history when editing.
startup_broadcasts.title: Manuscript hierarchy updated: revise Subsections, organize Sections
